title: Assistant Marketing Manager (DTC e-Commerce Business)
subtitle: About PATI Group
body:
## **About PATI Group**

PATI is a fast-growing E-commerce business specializing in dietary supplements, achieving a remarkable 500% increase in sales within just one year in the United States market. We're on a mission to become the leading dietary supplement company in Vietnam by 2026, offering innovative and high-quality products that inspire our customers to optimize their physical, mental, and intellectual potential.

As we continue our rapid growth trajectory, we're seeking a visionary **Assistant Marketing Manager (DTC e-Commerce Business)** to lead our marketing efforts and drive us towards these goals.

## Job Summary

As an **Assistant Marketing Manager**, you will be the key driver of PATI Group’s growth and profitability in the Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce space. The role’s primary objective is to drive revenue for the Men’s Health and Women’s Health collections, targeting $15M in revenue by 2025 while maintaining a 35% net profit margin. This position will also be responsible for leading and building a team of 2 marketing operations professionals, managing the P&L of the DTC business, and optimizing paid traffic channels, including Meta Ads, Google Ads, Email Marketing, AppLovin, TikTok Ads, and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO).

## **How We Measure Success**

- **Revenue Target:** Achieve $15M in revenue by 2025 for the DTC business.

- **Net Profit Target:** Maintain a 35% net profit margin.

- **Team Growth:** Support Marketing Manager to grow the Marketing Operations team from 3 to 10 by 2025.

- **Product Launch Success:** Achieve 30/60/90-day goals, including selling 1,000 units of Shilajit Capsule and $1.5M of Shilajit Gold within the first 90 days.

- **Return on Ad Spend (ROAS):** Achieve a 3x ROAS across paid media channels (Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads) within 12 months.

## Team Management

- **Reports to:** Marketing Manager and CEO.

- **Career Path:** Potential promotion to Deputy CMO based on performance.

- **Current team dynamic:** 3 Marketing Operators, working with cross-functional Influencer Marketing team of 4 and 4 performance marketing agencies.

- **Expected team size by 2025:** 10 Marketing Operators (3 Assistant Managers and 7 Senior Associates).

## **Core Responsibilities**

- **Revenue Growth:** Own and drive DTC revenue growth to $15M by 2025 through paid traffic strategies and CRO.

- **Paid Traffic Management:** Oversee all paid traffic initiatives, including Meta Ads, Google Ads, Email Marketing, TikTok Ads, and AppLovin, to maximize performance and ROI. Grow paid media ROAS from 3x to 5x within 12 months.

- **P&L Ownership:** Take full accountability for the DTC P&L, including managing advertising budgets and ensuring profitable unit economics.

- **SOP Development:** Develop lean and integrity-driven Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and dashboards for the Marketing Operations team. The goal is to reduce operational errors by 20% and increase team efficiency by 30%.

- **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work with the Influencer Marketing team, Community Manager, and Video Editors to generate creative assets for paid media campaigns. Facilitate monthly cross-team creative review sessions to optimize paid media performance.

## **Requirements**

### **Must-Have Requirements**

- **4-5+ years of experience in e-commerce marketing**, preferably with Shopify/TikTok Shop.

- **Technical Skills:** Hands-on experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, Email Marketing, AppLovin, TikTok Ads, and CRO tools.

- **Candidate Type:** Preferably is Plug-and-Play candidate; we are opened for "potential" candidates with tranferrable experience.

- **Tools & Platforms:** Proficiency in platforms such as Google Analytics, Shopify, and performance measurement dashboards.

- Alignment with our [core values and behaviors](https://www.patigroup.com/about) (We make no exception on any candidate who is not matched with our culture. Read more about our culture here: [https://www.patigroup.com/t/culture](https://www.patigroup.com/t/culture)).

### **Nice-to-Have Requirements**

- **Regional Experience:** Experience with U.S. or EU e-commerce markets.

- **Technical Skills:** Experience with Klaviyo and marketing automation tools.

- **Growth Experience:** Experience working in hyper-growth environments or startups scaling from Series A to Series C.

### **Behavioral Competencies**

- **Integrity:** The No. 1 required quality.

- **Data-Driven Decision-Making:** Ability to make unemotional, logic-based decisions, while leading with authenticity and empathy.

- **Discipline:** High level of discipline with zero tolerance for undisciplined behavior.

- **Psychological Understanding:** Understanding how performance creatives work for each ad platform.

- **Listening Skills:** Ability to make others feel heard and valued during discussions and team interactions.

- **Fluent English communication skills** (both written and spoken) are essential, as ***our office operates in a 100% English-speaking environment***. An IELTS score of 6.5 or higher (or equivalent) is required.

## **Compensation and Benefits**

- **Salary Range:** 18,000,000 - 27,000,000 VND/month.

- **Performance Bonuses:**

**Monthly Bonus:** If the team achieves a $1M net profit target, bonuses of $2K-$3K are paid monthly.

- **Annual Bonus:** This can be up to 10 months of salary, based on performance measured by net profit, SOP, and adherence to cultural key behaviors.

- **Equity Offer:** Potential to transition into a CMO role with an equity offer.

## **Working Location**

- On-site, 18A Street No. 38, An Khanh Ward, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam.

### **Working Hours**

- **Monday - Friday:** 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM.

- **Saturday (Culture Day):** 6:30 AM to 12:00 PM. We spend morning on running and reviewing our week.

### **Employment Type**

- Full-time, On-site.
